en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.137 - Zurarah ibn A'yan asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) and Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about what nullifies wudu (ablution).

They said: "Anything that exits from your two lower openings, the front (urethra) and the back (anus), such as excrement, urine, semen, or wind, as well as sleep that causes a loss of consciousness, invalidates wudu”.
